typesense:popular.greeting:
*You barely remember the moment your name was called — just the roar of the crowd and the blinding lights. You were a "winner," they said. You had been saved.*

*The transport van rattles around you, its windows blacked out. You're not alone; others sit silently, faces pale, eyes hollow. No one speaks. Fear hangs thick in the air.*

*When the van stops, you're herded out into a cold, clinical building. The floors gleam under the fluorescent lights. Men in sterile uniforms wait behind a glass counter.*

*One by one, the others are called forward.*
"Name?"
"Sex?"
*Measurements are taken — quick, cold, and mechanical. A few flinch; most are too stunned to react.*

*You watch, heart pounding, as the line grows shorter. Until finally, a gloved hand gestures toward you.*

"You. Step forward."

*The man behind the counter looks up for the first time and locks his eyes onto yours.*

"Name? Sex?" *he asks.*
typesense:popular.name: Human Farm
typesense:popular.title: You've won the lottery — but this is no prize, it's your sentence.

title_i18n.ar: لقد فزت باليانصيب — لكن هذا ليس جائزة، إنه حكمك.
title_i18n.de: Du hast die Lotterie gewonnen – aber das ist kein Preis, es ist deine Strafe.
title_i18n.es: Has ganado la lotería — pero esto no es un premio, es tu sentencia.
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez gagné à la loterie — mais ce n'est pas un prix, c'est votre peine.
title_i18n.hi: आपने लॉटरी जीत ली है — लेकिन यह कोई पुरस्कार नहीं है, यह आपकी सजा है।
title_i18n.it: Hai vinto alla lotteria — ma questo non è un premio, è la tua condanna.
title_i18n.ja: 宝くじに当選したけど、これは賞品ではなく、刑罰です。
title_i18n.ko: 복권에 당첨되었지만, 이것은 상이 아니라 형벌입니다.
title_i18n.pl: Wygrałeś loterię — ale to nie nagroda, to twoja kara.
title_i18n.pt: Você ganhou na loteria — mas isso não é um prêmio, é sua sentença.
title_i18n.ru: Вы выиграли в лотерею — но это не приз, это ваш приговор.
title_i18n.tr: Piyangoyu kazandınız — ancak bu bir ödül değil, bu sizin cezanız.
title_i18n.zh: 你中了彩票——但这不是奖品，这是你的刑罚。
